summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new dynamic categories management and supplier CRUD features. All 15 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend admin flows (Supplier tab CRUD, Pengaturan → Kategori Produk CRUD/toggle/edit/archive/delete) work end-to-end. Storefront reflects active categories (home tiles, katalog tabs, footer). Cleanup performed; 8 seeded categories intact.

issues: Repeated 401 console errors from unauthenticated admin API probes on public pages (carried over from prev iteration; non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: Suppliers endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE) currently require only forbid_cashier — any non-cashier admin can create/delete suppliers. If tighter permissions are desired (super_admin only for delete), consider hardening. Not a blocker for the requested feature.

In CategorySettings frontend, `category-delete-{id}` is disabled when product_count>0 but user is still allowed to open the delete alert dialog when product_count===0 for archived-only — flow is correct. Consider adding a visual 'archived' badge in the archived list rows (already visually indicated).
Public /api/products filters by active category names; if a product is created via legacy import with a non-existent category, it will be hidden. Existing behaviour matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed categories, products, and suppliers during tests; all cleaned up. Verified final /api/admin/categories count == 8 seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_categories_and_suppliers.py (pytest, 15 tests). Covers /api/categories, /api/config, /api/admin/categories CRUD (create, duplicate 400, rename propagates, archive hides from public+products, invalid/archived category on product 400, reorder, delete guard, delete empty archived) and /api/admin/suppliers CRUD. Frontend testids used: supplier-list-add-button, supplier-modal, supplier-nama/telepon/alamat/catatan, supplier-save, supplier-toggle-{id}, supplier-list-edit-{id}; category-settings-section, add-category-button, category-modal, category-name-input/tag-input/show-home-checkbox/save-button, category-row-{id}, category-toggle-home-{id}, category-edit-{id}, category-archive-{id}, toggle-archived-categories, archived-categories-list, category-delete-{id}, category-confirm-delete. Storefront: home-category-tile-<slug> (6 tiles), category-filter-tab-<slug> (9 including 'Semua'). ProductForm admin-category-select is behind a 4-digit PIN gate under Admin → Produk (not tested via UI due to PIN, but backend validation for archived/invalid category was covered).
